column_description: BIGSERIAL. Unique identifier for the power battery. PK.
TEXT. Reference to the equipment. FK to Equipment.EQUIP_CODE.

JSONB column. Captures the full real-time power and battery state of a unit (operating mode, SOC, health, charge parameters, consumption, efficiency) as a single JSONB blob.
